subject_v1: Tired of writing roofing bids at 9 PM?
body_v1:
Hey Austin Area Roofers team,

Most contractors I talk to around Austin, TX do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your roofing squares & shingle bundles automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about Austin Area Roofers's bidding process
body_v2:
Hey Austin Area Roofers team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for roofing pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates roofing squares & shingle bundles + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team

Hey West Roofing team,

Most contractors I talk to around Galway, Ireland do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your roofing squares & shingle bundles automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about West Roofing's bidding process
body_v2:
Hey West Roofing team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for roofing pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates roofing squares & shingle bundles + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team

body_v1:
Hey Email: team,

Most contractors I talk to do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about Email:'s bidding process
body_v2:
Hey Email: team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for contractor pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team

body_v1:
Hey Email: team,

Most contractors I talk to do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about Email:'s bidding process
body_v2:
Hey Email: team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for contractor pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,

Hey Email: team,

Most contractors I talk to do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about Email:'s bidding process
body_v2:
Hey Email: team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for contractor pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team

Hey Toiture MR Couvreurs team,

Most contractors I talk to do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about Toiture MR Couvreurs's bidding process
body_v2:
Hey Toiture MR Couvreurs team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for contractor pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates materials, labor markup & client PDF quotes + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/contractor-estimate-template.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=contractor

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team

Hey Pristine Roofing & Siding team,

Most contractors I talk to do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

You plug in the job dimensions (feet, inches, fractions), it calculates your roofing squares & shingle bundles automatically with waste %, and turns it into a branded PDF quote with your logo in 60 seconds.

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

You can use it 100% free on your next bid here:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
subject_v2: quick question about Pristine Roofing & Siding's bidding process
body_v2:
Hey Pristine Roofing & Siding team,

If you could hand a homeowner an itemized, professional PDF quote while still standing in their driveway—and close the job before your competitors even open their email—would that be useful to you?

Big software companies charge $50 to $150 every single month for bloated apps that take a week to learn.

We built the opposite for roofing pros:
- Zero setup: Open it on your phone or computer, type the job measurements in feet & inches.
- Automatic trade math: Calculates roofing squares & shingle bundles + labor + your markup instantly.
- Looks like a Fortune 500 company: Drops it into a clean PDF with your logo and a signature block.

No login required, no credit card, and completely free to test on your next bid:
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

Hope it saves you a couple of hours this week.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
